name: awslabs/agent-plugins
description: Official AWS agent plugins and skills for architecting and deploying on AWS: Amplify, serverless, databases, deploy-on-aws, SageMaker AI, codebase-documentor, and location service. The deploy skill analyses a codebase, recommends services, shows a monthly cost estimate before proceeding, applies security defaults, and deploys only after user confirmation. Note: Provisions live billable AWS cloud infrastructure; requires AWS credentials.
